# AnandRochlani

> Free, interview-focused engineering tutorials by Anand Rochlani, a Member of
> Technical Staff at Salesforce. Two topic clusters: System Design fundamentals
> and Coding Interview (LeetCode) patterns. Written explanations with original
> diagrams, worked examples and interview-ready answers.

Site: https://anandrochlani.com
Author: Anand Rochlani — Member of Technical Staff, Salesforce
Language: en-US
Contact: contact@anandrochlani.com

Every article is originally written, states its assumptions, and is intended to be
quoted with attribution to https://anandrochlani.com. Diagrams under /diagrams/ are
original SVGs and carry the site name.

## System Design

Scalability, load balancing, caching, sharding, replication, consistent hashing,
CAP theorem, SQL vs NoSQL, latency vs throughput, CDNs, message queues, rate
limiting, database indexing, plus complete case studies (Facebook News Feed,
Google Typeahead, a social bookmarking service, a coding contest platform).

- [System design interview preparation guide](https://anandrochlani.com/blog/system-design-interview-preparation-complete-guide-2026): the pillar — four-week roadmap, what is scored, how to practise.
- [System design interview framework](https://anandrochlani.com/blog/system-design-interview-framework-step-by-step-2026): the six-move structure for a 45-minute round.
- [Back-of-the-envelope estimation](https://anandrochlani.com/blog/back-of-the-envelope-estimation-system-design-interview): worked capacity maths from daily active users to server count.
- [Case study hub](https://anandrochlani.com/system-design-case-studies): five complete designs.
- [Glossary](https://anandrochlani.com/system-design-glossary): defined terms.

## Coding Interview

LeetCode pattern recognition for Amazon, Google and similar loops: two pointers,
sliding window, fast and slow pointers, stacks, modified binary search, tree BFS
and DFS, graphs on grids, topological sort, heaps and top-K, backtracking,
dynamic programming, greedy and intervals, tries and union-find.

- [The 15 LeetCode patterns](https://anandrochlani.com/blog/leetcode-patterns-coding-interview-guide): the pillar — each pattern with the recognition signal that triggers it.
- [Google coding interview questions](https://anandrochlani.com/blog/google-coding-interview-questions-preparation-guide): how Google's problem set and GCA scoring differ.

## Courses

- [System Design Fundamentals for Interviews](https://anandrochlani.com/courses/system-design-fundamental): published on Udemy, 49 lectures, 5h 40m.
- [Amazon Coding Interview Patterns](https://anandrochlani.com/courses/amazon-coding-interview-patterns): 111 lessons across 15 patterns. In production, not yet released.
- [Google Coding Interview: 50 Problems](https://anandrochlani.com/courses/google-coding-interview-50-problems): 50 Google-tagged problems in 11 pattern sections. In production, not yet released.
